data.name: Boston Lighthouse Sunset Cruise
data.headline: Boston's only lighthouse tour with the United States Coast Guard and National Park Service •All Ages
data.description: Experience the lighthouses of Boston Harbor Islands National and State Park through a special narrated cruise. Join us as we voyage through maritime history and pass renowned Boston Harbor landmarks on this three-lighthouse tour.
data.itinerary: This 2-hour cruise will sail past Long Island Light, Graves Light, and Boston Light, America's oldest light station. Narrations and programs on-board provided by staff and volunteers from the National Park Service and United States Coast Guard. ​

meeting_point.address: Boston Harbor Island Welcome Center on the Rose Kennedy Greenway at 191w Atlantic Avenue, Boston, MA 02110

data.what_to_bring: There is no food or water available on the boat. Feel free to bring your own snacks and meals.
data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation policy
Boston Light tickets are non-refundable 12 hours after purchase. If in the case of unsafe seas or reasons determined by the US Coast Guard or captain, visitor will be fully refunded or given the option to reschedule.

Trips run rain or shine, please plan accordingly.
data.booking_notes:
#Check-In Information
>All tours depart from the Boston Harbor Island Welcome Center on the Rose Kennedy Greenway at 191w Atlantic Avenue, Boston, MA 02110, directly across from the Long Wharf Marriott, Quincy Market and Aquarium MBTA Stop. Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your departure time, tours WILL NOT wait for tardy individuals.  
> The Boston Waterfront, is convenient to public transportation. The Aquarium Station lets out across the street from the Welcome Center.  South Station (on the Red Line and Commuter Rail) is a short walk (20 min). There are several parking lots nearby and are within a 5-10 minute walk; fees vary. Street parking in Boston is free on Sundays.

data.special_requirements:
- There is no public access to Little Brewster or Boston Light.
- Adverse weather conditions can force cancellations. Please check your email and voicemail before your trip. ​
- Alcohol, smoking and vaping are prohibited on the boat.
